snippet.title: LIMBY
snippet.description:
LIMBY is a twisted puzzle platformer. Play as Limby, a frat bro turned zombie. Traverse through 30 absurd and brain scrambling levels. Use your severed limbs to reach new heights and unlock new pathways to achieve your ultimate goal: Devour. The. Nerd.
Wishlist LIMBY on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433780/LIMBY/
